answer: Each identity climbs a public willow ladder for membership. Each rung is key-signed and its fee burned: the first costs 40 credits, each next rung costs 6 more, a delta of 6. Auditors replay the ladder; a rung bought from another key fails, so rented rungs burn the 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,037,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, so no fake ladder reaches the horizon. An honest agent climbs once, pays 40, keeps a full share.
